items.uz: Til nafaqat muloqot vositasi, balki tafakkur quroli hamdir.
items.en: Language is not only a means of communication, but also a tool of thought.

items.uz: Har bir til o'z ichida dunyoni idrok etishning o'ziga xos usulini yashiradi.
items.en: Every language hides within itself its own way of perceiving the world.

items.uz: So'zlarning ma'nosi kontekstga qarab o'zgarib turadi.
items.en: The meaning of words changes depending on context.

items.uz: Bu tilshunos so'zlarning kelib chiqishini chuqur o'rgangan.
items.en: This linguist has deeply studied the origin of words.

items.uz: Ba'zi tushunchalarni boshqa tilga aynan tarjima qilib bo'lmaydi.
items.en: Some concepts cannot be translated exactly into another language.

items.uz: Til jamiyat bilan birga rivojlanib boradi.
items.en: Language develops together with society.

items.uz: Nutq ohangi ba'zan so'zlardan ko'ra ko'proq narsani ifodalaydi.
items.en: Tone of voice sometimes expresses more than words.

items.uz: Bu nazariya tilning fikrlashga ta'sirini o'rganadi.
items.en: This theory studies language's influence on thought.

items.uz: Har bir metafora o'ziga xos madaniy zaminga ega.
items.en: Every metaphor has its own cultural background.

items.uz: Tilni yo'qotish bir butun dunyoqarashni yo'qotish demakdir.
items.en: Losing a language means losing an entire worldview.

items.uz: Bu olim so'zlarning botiniy ma'nosini tahlil qildi.
items.en: This scholar analyzed the inner meaning of words.

items.uz: Nutq va tafakkur bir-biri bilan chambarchas bog'liq.
items.en: Speech and thought are closely intertwined.

items.uz: Haqiqiy yetakchi so'zi bilan emas, ishi bilan namuna bo'ladi.
items.en: A true leader sets an example not by words, but by deeds.

items.uz: U jamoasiga ilhom bag'ishlay oladigan rahbar edi.
items.en: He/she was a leader who could inspire his/her team.

items.uz: Ta'sirchan shaxs boshqalarni o'z ortidan ergashtira oladi.
items.en: An influential person can make others follow them.

items.uz: Bu rahbar qiyin damlarda ham xotirjamligini yo'qotmadi.
items.en: This leader didn't lose his/her composure even in difficult moments.

items.uz: Yetakchilik mansab emas, mas'uliyatdir.
items.en: Leadership is not a position, it's a responsibility.

items.uz: U o'z xatolarini tan olishdan qo'rqmasdi.
items.en: He/she wasn't afraid to admit his/her mistakes.

items.uz: Kuchli yetakchi boshqalarning fikrini tinglashni biladi.
items.en: A strong leader knows how to listen to others' opinions.

items.uz: Bu inson o'z g'oyalari bilan ko'plarni ilhomlantirdi.
items.en: This person inspired many with his/her ideas.

items.uz: Ta'sir kuchi ishonch va hurmatdan tug'iladi.
items.en: The power of influence is born from trust and respect.

items.uz: U qiyinchiliklar oldida jamoasini birlashtira oldi.
items.en: He/she was able to unite his/her team in the face of difficulties.

items.uz: Haqiqiy yetakchi boshqalarning muvaffaqiyatidan xursand bo'ladi.
items.en: A true leader is happy about others' success.

items.uz: Bu rahbarning so'zlari hamon xotiramda saqlangan.
items.en: This leader's words are still preserved in my memory.
